coder_notes: The registered arms are both EXPERIMENTAL (TLX101-Tx + lomustine; TLX101-Tx only). The lomustine-alone control described in the official title and summary is not registered as an arm, so control_arm_from_other_arms is no; the adjudicator may want to review. Lomustine is coded soc_backbone because the design is TLX101-Tx added to lomustine versus lomustine alone (given in both comparison groups). Regimen coded combination for the pivotal TLX101-Tx + lomustine arm; the second arm is TLX101-Tx alone. [18F]FET PET is an eligibility imaging requirement and not a registered intervention, so not listed. Tumour dosimetry by SPECT is coded as tumour PK.
